import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Use the search box to filter projects by 'metaseq'
    try:
        search_box = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Filter by name", exact=True)
        await search_box.fill("metaseq")
        await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for search results to update
    except Exception as e:
        return f"Error using search box: {e}"
    
    # Step 2: Look for any project link that might have appeared after filtering
    # Since the tree doesn't show specific projects, I'll try to find a link with 'metaseq' in the name
    try:
        # Use case-insensitive substring match for 'metaseq'
        metaseq_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="metaseq", exact=False)
        await metaseq_link.click()
    except Exception as e:
        # If no link found, the project might not exist or be visible
        return "No project named 'metaseq' found after filtering. Cannot proceed to open an issue."
    
    await asyncio.sleep(3)  # Wait for project page to load
    
    # Step 3: Navigate to Issues section on the project page
    try:
        issues_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Issues", exact=True)
        await issues_link.click()
    except Exception as e:
        # Try case-insensitive if exact fails
        issues_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Issues", exact=False)
        await issues_link.click()
    
    await asyncio.sleep(3)
    
    # Step 4: Click New issue button or link
    try:
        new_issue_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="New issue", exact=True)
        await new_issue_button.click()
    except Exception as e:
        try:
            new_issue_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="New issue", exact=True)
            await new_issue_link.click()
        except Exception as e2:
            return f"Error finding New issue button/link: {e2}"
    
    await asyncio.sleep(3)
    
    # Step 5: Fill in the issue title and description
    try:
        title_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title", exact=True)
        await title_input.fill("Support for Llama and other llama family models")
    except Exception as e:
        return f"Error filling title: {e}"
    
    try:
        description_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Description", exact=True)
        await description_input.fill("Please provide information on your plan to support Llama and other models in the llama family within metaseq. This would be beneficial for users interested in these models.")
    except Exception as e:
        return f"Error filling description: {e}"
    
    # Step 6: Submit the issue
    try:
        submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Submit issue", exact=True)
        await submit_button.click()
    except Exception as e:
        return f"Error submitting issue: {e}"
    
    await asyncio.sleep(5)  # Wait for issue creation
    issue_url = page.url
    return issue_url
